items.stem: AI is changing many jobs. The most balanced view is:

options.C: Tasks shift; people adapt and oversee AI

items.stem: A healthy attitude toward AI at work is to:

options.A: Learn to use it well and check it

items.stem: Who benefits most when AI is shared fairly?
One real risk of AI in society is:

options.C: Bias or unfair outcomes if unchecked

items.stem: The best role for people alongside AI is usually:
Why talk about AI's impact rather than ignore it?

options.B: We can shape fair rules and habits

items.stem: AI in the economy will most likely:

options.C: Change tasks and create new roles

items.stem: A fair way to adopt AI is to:

options.A: Include the people it affects in decisions

items.stem: Your best response to AI change is to:

options.B: Keep learning and use it with judgment
